svg.title: Shadewright cause rule
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0039. The symptoms of one container, for example web in the Deployment demo/web, arrive as observations: an OOMKilled termination read from pod status, then a BackOff event and an Unhealthy probe event. The collector names the container and the class of each observation: cause (a container termination, or a kubelet Failed event on the container) or consequence (BackOff, probe Unhealthy). The Incident controller looks for an open cause Incident of the same subject and container. A cause opens its Incident as today. A consequence with an open cause is counted as evidence on the cause's Incident (status.absorbed: reason, count, last seen) and opens nothing. A consequence with no cause is held for the grace period, 2 minutes, and opens its own Incident only if the container still shows the symptom; otherwise it is dropped. When a cause opens up to 10 minutes after a consequence Incident of the same container, that Incident is closed as Resolved with the Lifecycle reason FoldedIntoCause, status.foldedInto naming the cause Incident, its counts kept; a request of it with no pull request yet ends Cancelled with reason IncidentFolded. The fingerprint does not change, and an unrelated problem of the same workload, such as a missing Secret on another container, keeps its own Incident.
